messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content: 我目前無法即時查詢最新的 ATP 或 WTA 排名。若您想知道最新的世界第一選手，建議直接查看官方網站（ATP/WTA）或使用專門提供即時體育數據的 API。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？" (Who is currently ranked number one tennis player?). We need to retrieve current ranking. Use the function sports_team_standing? But that's for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for individual player ranking. So we cannot use function. We can answer based on knowledge. As of 2026, but we don't know current ranking. We can say "I don't have real-time data." But maybe we can approximate: In 2026, top male player might be something like Carlos Alcaraz or Novak Djokovic? For women, Iga Swiatek? But we don't know. We should respond that we don't have real-time data.
